verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a hosted customer portal that lets customers manage their own accounts. It can be activated from the Dashboard with custom branding, and can be combined with Billing automations to automate customer interactions. However, the evidence never says the portal specifically lets customers upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscriptions, and it does not document embeddable components. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of self-service upgrade/downgrade/cancel in the portal, embeddable components, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel themselves through a hosted portal or embeddable components, without a support ticket

citations.quote: Give your customers the ability to manage their account by setting up a customer portal.
Use the Dashboard to activate the customer portal and optionally customize branding and prefill customer email addresses.
Automate many of your customer interactions by combining a customer portal with customer communications controlled by Stripe Billing automations.
